function: Learns the discrete RIS phase-shift configuration (column-wise DDQN actions, greedy element-wise refinement) to maximize the downlink sum rate (pp. 2-4).
system: Indoor multiuser downlink: 4-antenna femtocell BS, 100-element reflecting RIS (1-bit phases in Fig. 3a), 2 single-antenna users, 5.25 GHz, 10 MHz; direct links blocked (pp. 2, 4).
method: Double DQN with accumulated column-index actions plus an embedded greedy algorithm (DDQN-GA); reinforcement learning, reward is sum rate, fully connected Q-networks, 5000 episodes (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulated Rician channels in an 8x8x6 m room: LoS from distances with ITU-R P.1238 loss, i.i.d. NLoS, Rician factor 5; random BS and user positions (p. 4).
test_conditions: Agent trained on randomly generated indoor scenarios (10x10 RIS, 5000 episodes); curves averaged over random setups; Fig. 3c varies RIS size from 8x8 to 16x16 (pp. 3-5).
baselines: Non-learned: Flat, Random, PSO with quantization; learned: DQN [3], DDQN [8] (column-wise), plus own DDQN without greedy step (p. 4, Fig. 3).
metrics: Sum rate (Mbps) versus training steps and episodes and versus RIS size; DRL action-space size (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Big-O complexity O(IT((1+1/Nf) sum n_l n_(l-1) + PV)) over episodes I and steps T; action space grows as sqrt(N); no runtime or parameter count (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "adopting the ITU LoS basic transmission loss model [18]" (own Rician simulator: ITU-R P.1238 gives only the LoS path loss and the NLoS terms are i.i.d.; no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel).
q2_support: p. 5: "smoothed average curves across multiple randomly generated scenario setups" (results are DRL training curves and an RIS-size sweep in Fig. 3c; no trained agent is tested on a scenario, size or configuration unseen in training, nor after adaptation).
q3_support: p. 5: "Compared to DQN [3] and DDQN [8] in optimizing column-wise controlled RISs, the proposed DDQN-GA achieves significantly better performance" (sum rate in Fig. 3c, which also shows non-learned Random, Flat and PSO [17]; baselines listed on p. 4).
q4_support: p. 4: "the overall embedded GA complexity is O(IT P V )" (Section III-C also gives the total complexity O(IT((1+1/Nf) sum n_l n_(l-1) + PV)) of the proposed algorithm).
q5_support: p. 4: "we construct their LoS components based on the spatial distances between the FBS antennas, RIS elements, and users" (own simulated channels; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is mentioned anywhere in the letter).
notes: Area 3: the learned DDQN selects RIS column actions and the greedy step refines the elements; BS precoding is fixed RZF with perfect CSI (p. 2). ITU-R P.1238 is used only for the LoS path loss, so q1 is 0 and the reviewer may confirm. The RIS-size sweep of Fig. 3c is not counted for q2 because the state and action sizes depend on N (pp. 2-3) and the paper does not say that a trained agent is reused across sizes.
